template.description: Template id or slug. Omit when using `html` or `url`.

version.description: `published` (default), the name of a release channel such as `staging`, `latest` (the draft the editor works on, test keys only) or a version number. Channels, `published` included, are cached for up to a minute; a channel with a canary sends its share of renders to the canary version, chosen by the Idempotency-Key so a retry lands on the same version. A draft renders as it is at that moment.

output.description: Left out, the template decides: `pdf` for a template of kind `pdf`, `settings.image.format` (the request's, then the template's; `png` without one) for kind `image`, `settings.office.output` (else the template's own format) for kinds `docx` and `pptx`. Ad-hoc `html` and `url` render `pdf`. On the Free plan, test renders of `docx` and `pptx` templates may only request `pdf` (403 `test_output_unavailable`).

expires_in.description: Seconds until the output expires. `null` uses the workspace retention.

locale.description: Overrides the template locale and selects the i18n dictionary.

webhook_secret.description: Signs the deliveries to `webhook_url` (same scheme as an endpoint secret). Write-only, never returned; without it those deliveries stay unsigned.

meta.description: Echoed in the response and webhooks.

dedupe.description: Serve identical requests from the dedup cache at zero units.

canary_key.description: Decides the canary split of a channel: renders with the same value land on the same version, so one customer's documents look alike. Use an opaque id; it is not stored. Without it the Idempotency-Key decides, which keeps a retry on its version but splits separate renders independently.

validate_data.description: Checks `data` against the template's stored data schema before anything is rendered or counted; a mismatch answers 422 `data_validation_error` listing every error. Needs a template with a stored schema (400 otherwise). In a batch, nothing is queued unless every item that asks for it fits.

post.description:
Post-processing of a PDF render, applied in the order merge, watermark, password (0.5 units
per step on live keys; Starter plan and above). An unknown step is refused, never skipped.

merge_after.description: PDFs appended after this document, in order: render ids (`rnd_…`) of earlier renders, file ids (`fil_…`) or names of PDFs in the workspace library.

watermark.description: Either a text or an image from the workspace library, not both.

image.description: A library file: its id (`fil_…`) or its name. PNG or JPEG.

color.description: Hex colour of the text; ignored for an image.

owner.description: Lifts the restrictions; random when omitted.

OutputFormat.description: PDF and image templates, ad-hoc HTML and URLs produce `pdf`, `png`, `jpg` or `webp`; a `docx` template produces `docx` or `pdf`, a `pptx` template `pptx` or `pdf`.

Settings.description: Rendering settings. Deep-merged over the template's settings. See the settings reference.

header.description: Printed across the whole page width inside the top margin.

padding.description: CSS padding inside the header box; `0` for designs that run edge to edge.

footer.description: Printed across the whole page width inside the bottom margin.

padding.description: CSS padding inside the footer box; `0` for designs that run edge to edge.

format.description: Output of an image template when the request names no `output`. `jpg` is accepted as well.

office.description: Word and PowerPoint templates. Page setup, margins, headers and footers come from the document; the Chromium settings above do not apply.

output.description: Output when the request names none; the template's own format without it.

StorageOption.description:
The copy for the workspace's own bucket (bring your own storage). Left out, every output is
copied under the connection's key template. `false` leaves this document out. `key` names its
object below the connection's prefix instead of the key template: relative, without `.` or `..`
segments, at most 1024 bytes; an existing object is overwritten. A render with its own key is
never answered from the dedup cache, and one without a connection answers 409
`storage_not_configured`. In a batch, each item carries its own.
